title: Sources: social media companies' payouts in teen addiction suits mostly ranged from $2M-$2.5M; Meta agreed to pay two teens a combined $7M in the past two weeks (Olivia Carville/Bloomberg)
summary: Olivia Carville / Bloomberg: Sources: social media companies' payouts in teen addiction suits mostly ranged from $2M-$2.5M; Meta agreed to pay two teens a combined $7M in the past two weeks — Seven confidential deals with young plaintiffs ranged from $2 million to $2.5 million.
